decisions.title: Public source root
decisions.proposedDecision: Adopt Data.Source(name) as the provider-neutral root for source policy, inspection, mapping, and operations.

decisions.title: Source composition
decisions.proposedDecision: Freeze duplicate-rejecting, immutable, host-scoped source and catalog plans at composition.

decisions.title: Source policy
decisions.proposedDecision: Adopt StorageLifecycle Managed/External, Access ReadWrite/ReadOnly, and explicit ReadLanes with one fail-fast gate.

decisions.title: Alternate paths
decisions.proposedDecision: Require every Entity, batch, transaction, Direct, instruction, patch, transfer, and connection override path to carry an effect and pass the same source gate.

decisions.title: Readiness boundary
decisions.proposedDecision: Split route readiness from explicit shape provisioning; forbid operation replay after possible provider dispatch and map failures by exact type/code.

decisions.title: Neutral inspection
decisions.proposedDecision: Use collection/address/reference/traits descriptors rather than table/schema vocabulary, with opaque provider-safe resolution.

decisions.title: Neutral results
decisions.proposedDecision: Adopt bounded RecordSet with ordered fields, duplicate-name preservation, ordinals, provider values/types, multiple channels, limits, and completion reason.

decisions.title: Projection materializer
decisions.proposedDecision: Compile and reuse ordinal DTO plans for mutable, immutable, and positional targets without per-row JSON conversion.

decisions.title: Mapping grammar
decisions.proposedDecision: Adopt Map, Container, Key, Property, Name, Path, and Object as the compact provider-neutral mapping grammar.

decisions.title: Mapping semantics
decisions.proposedDecision: Compile one authoritative immutable mapping plan including composite/generated keys, codecs, structured ownership, indexes, and mutation maintenance.

decisions.title: Registered operations
decisions.proposedDecision: Adopt a frozen per-source operation catalog addressed by Query, Scalar, Lane, and Template.

decisions.title: Operation contract
decisions.proposedDecision: Model operation effect, result kind, delivery, parameters, bounds, and native binding explicitly; Unknown fails closed.

decisions.title: Native payloads
decisions.proposedDecision: Keep provider payloads behind explicit Sql, Pipeline, Function, or adapter-native bindings; do not leak provider vocabulary into common descriptors.

decisions.title: Plans and receipts
decisions.proposedDecision: Make capabilities, Describe, Explain, execution receipts, telemetry, facts, health, and errors project the same compiled decision identities.

decisions.title: Atomicity
decisions.proposedDecision: Claim atomicity only for one proved native boundary; name cross-adapter coordination as non-atomic unless an explicit distributed protocol exists.

decisions.title: Ownership and hot path
decisions.proposedDecision: Make route/readiness/mapping/materializer/operation caches host-scoped, immutable, bounded, and free of warm-path reflection or structural work.

decisions.title: Diagnostics and truth
decisions.proposedDecision: Redact secrets, values, tenant/entity identifiers, and raw native messages; reconcile docs and product claims to executable evidence.

decisions.title: Vector boundary
decisions.proposedDecision: Ratify a stable Vector annex before applying the record-adapter runner to Vector connectors.
